title: Linux kernel Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) documentation

date.notes: Current documentation; contains historical v4.7/v4.8 transition notes.

claims_extracted.claim: Linux VRF devices associate an L3 master with a routing table and use policy rules; before Linux 4.8 per-VRF iif/oif rules were required, while Linux 4.8 added a common l3mdev FIB rule. iproute2 supports the vrf keyword as of v4.7.
claims_extracted.locator: Setup and Using iproute2 for VRFs

notes: Primary current documentation preserving explicit migration notes.
